editorial.blurb: Hongdae Sushi & Grill delivers some of the best sushi around with generous rolls, pristine nigiri, and a vibrant atmosphere that keeps guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Grab a reservation for early evening (like 5pm) to enjoy a less-crowded experience, and don't miss their Sushi Boat if you're a nigiri lover—it's the star of the menu.
